title: What I <g>Automate</g>
First
subtitle: Most tasks never make the cut. Four filters, one winner.

cards.title: Every task in a normal week
cards.body: I list all of it with the team. Nothing is too small to write down.

cards.title: Happens every week
cards.body: One-offs stay manual. Repetition is where time leaks.

cards.title: Done the same way each time
cards.body: If two people do it two ways, we fix it first.

cards.title: Safe if it goes wrong
cards.body: No money, no client name on it. Lower your risk first.
